rationale.target_design: Nakashima-like independently identifying detection design at substantially larger spatial and temporal scale

pass_if_any: paired or double-observer member identity retained in public schema
deployment-linked distance/detection calibration retained separately from biological response
auxiliary detection stream linked to the same physical deployments
another predeclared response-independent mechanism that identifies detection separately from activity
reject_if: field study used paired cameras but public response collapses pair-member identity
camera model names exist but no overlap/calibration identifies detection
detection can only be inferred from focal biological response

hard_entry_requirements.requirement: the detection/source/protocol factor used for G4 must occur in at least two geographic regimes so it is not perfectly confounded with geography
D1 and D2 must be established from public methods/schema/metadata before focal response rows, focal diel distributions, focal counts, or predictive scores are inspected

preferred_search_classes: large double-observer or paired-camera networks retaining camera-member identity
multi-region camera-distance-sampling networks with deployment-linked calibration distances
multi-region camera networks with independent sensor-calibration trials tied to deployments
public multi-project repositories where the same detection-calibration protocol overlaps multiple geographies
deprioritized_classes: single-protocol multi-city networks with one camera per site
paired-camera field studies whose released data collapse pair identity
single-region detection studies regardless of sample size
long-duration monitoring with no separately identifying detection stream
